Layer 1 — CDCFIB fixes November 13 deadline, announces free drug test
ABUJA — The Civil Defence, Correctional, Fire and Immigration Services Board (CDCFIB) will open its recruitment portal on October 28 and close it on November 13.
The board’s Secretary, Major General Abdul Malik Jibril (retd.), disclosed this on Thursday in Abuja.
Jibril also directed candidates who had reached the oral stage of the recruitment process to check their status and undergo a mandatory drug test with the National Drug Law Enforcement Agency (NDLEA) in their respective states or places of residence.
